---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with SWARA
---

## Reproduction

Describe the steps, expected result, and actual result.

## Context

Include the revision, browser or runtime, and affected feature. For UI bugs, include the practice language and viewport when relevant. Say whether this used a local server, a deployment, or fixture responses.

Include relevant screenshots or log excerpts with credentials and personal data removed. Report vulnerabilities privately using the security policy.
